data.name: EngineName
data.comment: Shown as the title when the game's own title couldn't be loaded.

data.name: DataLoadErrorsHeader
data.value: There were problems loading the game data:

data.name: DataFileNotFound
data.value: The file could not be found.

data.name: DataFileReadError
data.value: The file could not be read. {0}
data.comment: {0} is the system error message.

data.name: DataFileInvalidJson
data.comment: {0} is the JSON parser's error message.

data.name: DataFileInvalidImage
data.value: The file is not a supported image. {0}
data.comment: {0} is the image decoder's error message.

data.name: GameInfoIconInvalid
data.value: The icon "{0}" must be a file path relative to the data folder.
data.comment: {0} is the icon path found in the data file.

data.name: DataListEmpty
data.value: The "{0}" list must have at least one item.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: DataListItemEmpty
data.value: The "{0}" list has an empty item.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: DataListItemIdMissing
data.value: An item in the "{0}" list is missing an id.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: DataListItemIdDuplicate
data.value: The id "{0}" is used more than once in the "{1}" list.
data.comment: {0} is the duplicated id. {1} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: DataListItemTitleMissing
data.value: The item "{0}" in the "{1}" list is missing a title.
data.comment: {0} is the item's id. {1} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: DataListItemFrequencyInvalid
data.value: The item "{0}" in the "{1}" list has a frequency of {2}, but it must be from {3} to {4}.
data.comment: {0} is the item's id. {1} is the name of the list in the data file. {2} is the frequency found. {3} and {4} are the allowed minimum and maximum.

data.name: DataListItemDescriptionMissing
data.value: The item "{0}" in the "{1}" list is missing a description.
data.comment: {0} is the item's id. {1} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: ProfessionDefaultLastNameMissing
data.value: The profession "{0}" is missing a default last name.
data.comment: {0} is the profession's id.

data.name: NameMissing
data.value: A name in the "{0}" list is blank.
data.comment: {0} is the name of the list in the data file.

data.name: NameFrequencyInvalid
data.value: The name "{0}" in the "{1}" list has a frequency of {2}, but it must be from {3} to {4}.
data.comment: {0} is the name. {1} is the name of the list in the data file. {2} is the frequency found. {3} and {4} are the allowed minimum and maximum.

data.name: PlayerMinimumAgeInvalid
data.value: The player minimum age is {0}, but it must be at least 1.
data.comment: {0} is the age found in the data file.

data.name: PlayerMaximumAgeInvalid
data.value: The player maximum age is {0}, but it must be at least the player minimum age ({1}).
data.comment: {0} is the maximum age found in the data file. {1} is the minimum age found in the data file.

data.name: LocationDescriptionMissing
data.comment: {0} is the location's id. {1} is the name of the missing description in the data file.

data.name: LocationDescriptionParagraphBlank
data.value: The location "{0}" has a blank paragraph in its long description.
data.comment: {0} is the location's id.

data.name: LocationConnectionBlank
data.value: The location "{0}" has a blank connection.
data.comment: {0} is the location's id.

data.name: LocationConnectionUnknown
data.value: The location "{0}" connects to "{1}", but there is no location with that id.
data.comment: {0} is the location's id. {1} is the id of the connected location.

data.name: LocationConnectionToSelf
data.comment: {0} is the location's id.

data.name: StartingLocationUnknown
data.value: The starting location is "{0}", but there is no location with that id.
data.comment: {0} is the starting location's id.

data.name: NpcMinimumAgeInvalid
data.value: The NPC minimum age is {0}, but it must be at least 1.
data.comment: {0} is the age found in the data file.

data.name: NpcMaximumAgeInvalid
data.value: The NPC maximum age is {0}, but it must be at least the NPC minimum age ({1}).
data.comment: {0} is the maximum age found in the data file. {1} is the minimum age found in the data file.

data.name: RandomizeField
data.comment: Button next to a single field that picks a new random value for it.

data.name: RandomizeAll
data.comment: Button that picks new random values for every field that can be randomized.

data.name: Back
data.comment: Button that leaves the new game screen and returns to the start up menu.

data.name: ExamineLocation
data.comment: Button that shows a detailed description of the current location.

data.name: ConnectionsHeader
data.value: From here you can go to:
data.comment: Header above the list of locations the player can travel to.

data.name: PeopleHeader
data.comment: Header above the list of characters in the current location.

data.name: ExamineCharacter
data.comment: Button that shows a description of a character.

data.name: CharacterDescription
data.value: {0} is a {1} of {2}. {3} is {4} and {5}, and works as {6}.
data.comment: {0} is the character's full name. {1} is a noun for their gender (such as "man"). {2} is their age. {3} is a capitalized pronoun for their gender (such as "He"). {4} and {5} are descriptions of their height and weight from the data files (such as "tall" and "of average build"). {6} is a description of their profession from the data files (such as "a blacksmith").

data.name: GenderPronounMale
data.comment: Capitalized, since it starts a sentence.

data.name: GenderPronounFemale
data.comment: Capitalized, since it starts a sentence.
